home.about_desc: Ar Grup Makine has been operating since 1975 and still meets the demands and expectations of its customers in the fastest and highest quality manner in the light of technological developments. We serve as the approved main sub-industry for Agricultural Machinery, Construction Machinery, Defense and Automotive primary manufacturers.
home.uretim_desc: We carry out sheet metal forming and assembly with state-of-the-art machines in our factory with 9500 m² closed area in Sincan Organized Industrial Zone.
home.cnc_desc: We machine medical, defense, and automotive parts with tight tolerances using our high-precision vertical machining centers and CNC lathes.
home.pres_desc: We perform sheet metal forming, deep drawing, and progressive die stamping with our eccentric and hydraulic press lines.
home.robot_desc: We assemble chassis and heavy body groups with our ISO 3834-2 certified welded manufacturing system and robotic welding cells.
home.sektor_desc: We produce high-engineering components for critical sectors with our wide production range.
